author: 滇西小哥 Dianxi Xiaoge
description:
※Click "cc" on the lower right menu to choose your subtitle language.

This episode is a collection of the Roots on the Table series.

Most of these foods grow in the soil, still covered with earth when they are first dug up. After being washed clean, they can be steamed, boiled, stewed, or stir-fried in the most ordinary home-style ways, turning into a simple and hearty meal.

They are not rare ingredients, but they are the kind of food many people grew up eating. There is joy in digging them out of the ground, warmth in cooking them at home, and a plain, comforting taste when they are served on the table.

This episode brings the Roots on the Table series together, so you can slowly watch these familiar home-style flavors that grow from the land.
